issues.desc: The background/checklist names the user value as migrating active Orchestrate worktrees into proofbound plus adding host-neutral retired-root protection, but the checklist only documents that B-3523 and B-fbb6 were migrated; it does not require a user-observable migration/verification outcome such as proofbound worktrees existing, Orchestrate worktrees retired/read-only, and resumed story state matching. As written, the user could still wonder whether the active work was actually moved or merely described.

Several checklist items are framed as implementation mechanics (configuration semantics, command-policy enforcement, focused tests) without explicit user-observable completion language. The guard value is directionally clear, but INIT would be stronger if each item stated what the user can see afterward: reads still work in Orchestrate, mutating commands fail with the canonical proofbound path, override use is narrow/auditable, and migrated stories can continue from proofbound.
